decisions: AddOutboxRelay requires the host to register IClock and the TContext DbContext; the batch processor is scoped and resolved per cycle by OutboxRelayService.
Transport is registered with TryAddSingleton so several AddOutboxRelay<TContext> calls in one host share a single EventBusPublisher.
A failure while deserializing a payload is treated as a delivery failure (RegisterFailure) and stops the batch, preserving order.

HandleFamily<TMarker,...> requires TMarker : IIntegrationEvent (needed for IIntegrationEventHandler<TMarker>); IRoutineSnapshotEvent/IServiceOrderSnapshotEvent do not extend it, so they must to be usa…
Registry key is the EventName; the dispatcher extracts it from envelope.Type (rutaviva.{svc}.{Name}.v1 -> Name, or the raw type if not in that format).
Host/dispatcher are internal; the service must register its own scoped IEventCheckpointStore and IUnitOfWork for Checkpoint (Latest gets in-memory and null defaults via TryAdd).
